result:
Round 482 is planned as a regression round: C re-checks everything finished in rounds 426–481 in the browser, and A changes no code. The decision is CONTINUE.

**Round 481:** C passed all 8 rows in the browser with 0 bugs, and root published it as `751e30e` on both remotes. The My Orders link fix is confirmed, but B-R478-DEAD-MUSIC-LINK stays open. The protected `account.downloads.tsx` page still links to `/music`, and only root can change that (ROOT-REQ-DOWNLOADS-MUSIC-LINK). Nothing new is marked მზადაა. I copied the round-481 task to `tasks/round-481.md` before replacing it.

**Round 482 (REGRESSION-2026-11-13, part 1):**
- **Timing:** I started planning 13 minutes before the 3-day mark, so the regression runs slightly early. A and C run on 2026-11-13, round 423 set the same precedent, and D-29z1709 had already scheduled it. `regression-last.json` stays unchanged until part 2 closes.
- **What C checks:** one short check per finished item, at 1440×900 and 1280×720.
  - **Studio:** held-key guards, Saba's five native-control fixes (SABA-B-12), copy and export look, and IME input.
  - **Store:** popup routes, colours and tokens, seek thumb, entrance, fonts, scroll smoothness, in-app links and My Orders.
  - **General:** the full perf suite on its own, perf-lib tests, the e2e smoke run, the auth guard and the buyer journey.
- **Scope additions:** all 9 have their own row (each SABA-B-12 stage counts as one). The six older carries from the last regression go to part 2.
- **Comparison baselines:** many later rounds changed the same screens that earlier rounds measured. I mapped which round last touched each one, and each row compares against that latest result. The earlier glow and teal measurements are no longer used.
- **Checked before hand-off:** I ran one probe per kind on `751e30e`, and all matched their stored results.
  - Spin buttons: 6/6.
  - Held Enter: 28/28.
  - IME: 18/18.
  - Store colours: 18/18 against round 474.
  - Round-475 badge and card values: equal, with the mock API, which I stopped afterwards.

  These checks showed that the older compare scripts need each round's own pre-fix `head/` folder, so the task now gives the exact command for every row.
- **Two loosened checks:** round 470 measured the scroll end position and the "look" brightness band before the font change in round 473. The task now asserts "scrolls to the bottom" instead of the old pixel numbers and only records the brightness band.
- **Cart confirm dialog:** the mock API returns an empty cart, so C tries `page.route` stubs first. It is marked BLOCKED, with the exact reason, only if the dialog still cannot be reached.

**Order after this:**
- 483: regression part 2 (everything up to round 425, plus the older carries).
- 484: CLIENT-NAV-CONTRACT (GATE479-M1).
- 485: B-R480-ORDER-CARD-KEYBOARD.
- Then DPG-BUTTON-CLEANUP.

A Critical, High or cloud-reproducible Medium finding in round 482 would move its fix ahead of part 2.

**Consults:** the advisor was available and reviewed twice. All ten of its points are applied. No project agent was needed, because this round has no new behaviour and no code change. I did not request an architecture checkpoint.

The store working tree is still clean at `751e30e`. The claims script finds all 102 cited files with no errors, and the backlog is now at v471 with decisions D-29z1712 to D-29z1715.

Files are in `tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- current-task.md
- b-round-481.md
- b-next.json
